summary_for_children: Al-Jumu'ah means Friday. It tells us to leave trade and go to the prayer when called on Friday, then go out and seek Allah's bounty.
environment_concept: Market stalls shut for the Friday prayer (62:9) and reopened afterwards (62:10).
architecture_and_scenery: Market stalls, a call to prayer, and a mosque courtyard.

areas.name: Market
areas.description: Busy stalls that close for prayer.

activities.name: Close the stall
activities.description: Pause trade when the call comes (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Seek bounty
activities.description: After the prayer, carry four baskets to the open stalls.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (market, mosque) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A busy market street on Friday morning with fruit stalls under awnings and a domed mosque with a minaret at the top

primary_mechanic.text: Keep a fruit stall and give each unseen customer what they ask for; mid-sale the call for the Friday prayer comes (shown as words) and selling is refused until you close the stall and walk to the mosque; after the prayer (not played) reopen and sell again (62:9-10).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the top of the street, the stall and the call, the mosque, then a reading at the mosque
environment_behaviour: the stall is covered with a cloth while shut
the mosque door glows when it is time
unique_world.learning_objective: Know to leave trade at the Friday call and seek bounty after the prayer (62:9-10)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: A Special Day Together
story_library.children_narration: Friday is an important day for Muslim communities. The Quran teaches believers to give attention to the remembrance of Allah when called to Friday prayer, rather than being distracted by trade and other activities.

world_idea.title: The Friday Town
world_idea.description: Explore a peaceful town as its weekly routine changes. Learn about the importance of gathering, listening, and making time for worship through interactive scheduling and exploration.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
